title: Correct a boundary differential without changing the graded cycle class
statement: Let C be abelian, K a cochain complex, F a decreasing filtration (def-sp-filtration and def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients), r >= 1, and i,j related by bidegree (r,1-r). Let t,tprime from an object A into the i and j filtration steps, and x,y into their graded r-cycles, satisfy dt=tprime and the two graded representative equations. If y maps to zero under the target page quotient (lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential), then after an epimorphism e:B -> A there is a morphism z:B -> graded (r+1)-cycles at i whose graded inclusion equals e followed by x and its graded inclusion. This asserts only correction of given simultaneous representatives; it mentions no page differential data D or map to its kernel.

proof.text: Factor y through the monic boundary inclusion using Abelian.monoLift and the page cokernel equation. Apply Subobject.exists_fac and surjective_up_to_refinements_of_epi to lift the graded boundary to V, the pullback of the incoming boundary sum with the higher filtration step. The difference from the given target representative is killed by the graded projection. Evaluate the exact cokernel sequence of complexes and apply exact_up_to_refinements to lift that difference to the higher filtration step. Lift the V representative along the proved epic Subobject.supDesc of the two ambient subobjects, then lift its incoming-boundary component along factorThruImageSubobject. Composing these four epic refinements yields etprime = db + c, with b in the source higher filtration step and c in the target higher filtration step. Set u = et - b followed by the inclusion. Its differential equals c, so u factors through the successor-cycle intersection and hence its graded image. The cokernel condition kills b in the source graded piece; hx identifies that image with ex. These steps are implemented by a proved private boundary-lift helper and the complete public proof.

theorem filteredComplex_cycle_representative_correction
    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K) (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (i j : ℤ × ℤ) (hij : (ComplexShape.up' (r, 1 - r)).Rel i j)
    (A : C)
    (t : A ⟶ (F.step i.1 : CochainComplex C ℤ).X (i.1 + i.2))
    (t' : A ⟶ (F.step j.1 : CochainComplex C ℤ).X (j.1 + j.2))
    (x : A ⟶ (F.complexCycles i.1 (i.1 + i.2) r : C))
    (y : A ⟶ (F.complexCycles j.1 (j.1 + j.2) r : C))
    (ht : t ≫ (F.step i.1).arrow.f (i.1 + i.2) ≫
      K.d (i.1 + i.2) (j.1 + j.2) = t' ≫ (F.step j.1).arrow.f (j.1 + j.2))
    (hx : x ≫ (F.complexCycles i.1 (i.1 + i.2) r).arrow =
      t ≫ (F.complexQuotientπ i.1 (i.1 + 1) (by omega)).f (i.1 + i.2))
    (hy : y ≫ (F.complexCycles j.1 (j.1 + j.2) r).arrow =
      t' ≫ (F.complexQuotientπ j.1 (j.1 + 1) (by omega)).f (j.1 + j.2))
    (hy0 : y ≫ filteredComplexPageπ K F r j = 0) :
    ∃ (B : C) (e : B ⟶ A), Epi e ∧
      ∃ z : B ⟶ (F.complexCycles i.1 (i.1 + i.2) (r + 1) : C),
        z ≫ (F.complexCycles i.1 (i.1 + i.2) (r + 1)).arrow =
          e ≫ x ≫ (F.complexCycles i.1 (i.1 + i.2) r).arrow
